resources.string: No email app is available. Contact %1$s from your preferred email service.

1. Choose your destination
Paste a public HTTPS link, or share one from your browser to nfcraft. Save link keeps it in your 10 recent destinations. Saving a link does not write a card.

2. Check your card
Use an unlocked, factory-default NTAG215. Inspect only reads without writing. Other tag types, payment cards, and access badges are not supported.

3. Write and verify
Turn Inspect only OFF when ready to write. Hold the card still against your phone’s NFC antenna until Written, Finished, or Already done appears. Keep the phone unlocked and nfcraft open.

4. Try another phone
Remove the card, leave nfcraft, and scan it with a different phone to check the destination. A successful write is not proof that the website works.

If contact is lost
Keep the same destination and card. Follow the result on screen; an interrupted write may have changed the card. Do not enable overwrite just to dismiss an error.

Privacy and control
Anyone scanning the card can read its link. Do not write secret links. nfcraft never locks a card; it can still be rewritten. Opening a dialog pauses new scans. Unknown-content overwrite turns off when you leave the app.
Open your phone’s Settings and enable NFC, then return to nfcraft.
Wait for the current card operation to finish, then try again.

Only enable this for a card you own and intend to rewrite. Existing content in the write region may be lost. Protection checks and full readback stay enabled. This permission turns off when you leave nfcraft.
%1$s\n\nThis will replace the destination and save it in your recent links. Inspect only will be ON. Nothing is written or opened automatically.
Share a single public HTTPS URL, up to 200 ASCII bytes, without a fragment or login credentials. Extra text and multiple links are not imported. Your current destination is unchanged.
Finish the current shared-link confirmation first.
Move your saved links between installations. Export shows only recent URLs, one per line. Import validates and previews a merged list before saving. Your current destination and cards stay unchanged.
Long-press the list to select and copy. Copying puts links on the system clipboard; your keyboard or clipboard service may retain them. Keep the copy private. Unsaved input is not included.
Paste HTTPS links, one per line
Up to 10 distinct links. Existing links keep their order; new links are added after them. Invalid input or an overfull list changes nothing.

Result: %1$d/10 saved links

%2$s

Save this list? The current destination stays unchanged. Inspect only will be ON and overwrite permission OFF. No card is written.
Links imported. Inspect only is ON.
Save a valid HTTPS link or use it with a card. Your last 10 destinations stay on this phone.
Remove all saved recent links from this phone? The current destination stays in the input field. No card is changed.

Your destination, up to 10 recent links, and switches are stored only on this phone. Clear recent links from Recent → Clear history. To remove the current destination, delete it from the input field. Android app storage settings can remove all app settings. Recent → Transfer links lets you manually copy or import saved URLs. Copying uses the system clipboard; your keyboard or clipboard service may retain copies. Clear history does not remove those copies.

The app has no Internet permission, account, advertising, or analytics. NFC card identifiers and readback appear on screen during use; the app does not upload them. Cloud backup and Android 12+ device transfer are excluded for app data.

A link written to a card is readable by anyone who scans it. The destination website has its own privacy practices. Clearing app history does not erase a card.
